input.free_text_description: The system operates in the e-commerce, microservices infrastructure domain. It serves API Consumer, Customer as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include inventory, order, product. Core business data revolves around Inventory, Order.

user_stories.story: As a Customer, I want to place and track orders, so that I can purchase items and monitor their delivery status.
As a Customer, I want to browse and manage products, so that I can find and interact with the product catalog.
As a API Consumer, I want to receive notifications about relevant activity, so that I stay informed about updates that matter to me.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage application configuration centrally, so that all services pick up the latest settings without redeployment.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage inventory operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
